metadata.title: A new look at the kinematics of the bulge from an N-body model

notes: No eligible stars. The paper analyzes an N-body simulation of bulge star particles rather than individually identifiable stars (T:p1-b6, T:p3-b3). The high-velocity peaks and stellar groups discussed are not identified as Galactic unbound candidates (e.g., T:p9-b2).
